# Code.org

> > Code.org is a nonprofit education platform providing free K-12 computer science and AI literacy curriculum, featuring Hour of Code, Hour of AI, and interactive learning tools like App Lab, Game Lab, and Web Lab.

Led by CEO Karim Meghji, Code.org partners with organizations like LEGO Education and CodeYogi to deliver accessible CS education globally. The platform includes AI-powered tools such as the AI Tutor (using Gemini Flash 2.5 and ChatGPT-4o) and the award-winning AI Teaching Assistant for automated assessment.

## Key Topics

- Hour of AI
- Hour of Code
- AI literacy and education
- Computer science education (K-12)
- App Lab, Game Lab, Web Lab
- AI Tutor (Gemini Flash 2.5, ChatGPT-4o)
- AI Teaching Assistant
- Block-based coding
- Self-paced tutorials
- CS Journeys career pathways
- Teacher training and professional development
- LEGO Education partnership
- Student scholarships and internships
- Karim Meghji (CEO)
- Global CS education partnerships

## Student Learning Resources

- [Computer Science for Students | Learn, Explore, and Create with Code.org](https://code.org/de/students): Student portal for CS learning paths, projects, careers with App/Game/Web Lab
- [Computer Science for Students | Learn, Explore, and Create with Code.org](https://code.org/pt-BR/students): Student hub with AI learning, coding tutorials, and career exploration tools
- [Computer Science for Students | Learn, Explore, and Create with Code.org](https://code.org/en-US/students): Student resources with Hour of AI, App Lab, Game Lab, and Web Lab access
- [Free K–12 Curriculum for Computer Science and AI | Code.org](https://code.org/fa): Homepage featuring Hour of Code, Hour of AI, and LEGO Education partnership

## AI-Powered Teaching Tools

- [AI Tutor](https://code.org/ar/tools/ai-tutor): AI-powered Socratic learning companion using Gemini Flash 2.5 and ChatGPT-4o
- [AI Tutor](https://code.org/zh-Hans/tools/ai-tutor): Educational AI companion with Socratic method for problem-solving support
- [AI Teaching Assistant | Save Time and Boost Teaching with Code.org](https://code.org/cs/artificial-intelligence/teaching-assistant): Education Week award-winning automated assessment tool for CS Discoveries
- [AI Teaching Assistant | Save Time and Boost Teaching with Code.org](https://code.org/it/artificial-intelligence/teaching-assistant): Best of STEM award-winning grading automation for coding project assessments

## Hour of AI Activities

- [Mix and Move with AI | Hour of AI Classroom Activity | Code.org](https://code.org/es-ES/mix-move-ai): Hour of AI activity combining dance and coding with Sabrina Carpenter music
- [Hour of AI India with CodeYogi | Code.org](https://code.org/zh-Hans/india/codeyogi): India partnership with CodeYogi for AI for Oceans smartphone learning activity

## Curriculum and Incubator Programs

- [Incubator](https://code.org/es/incubator): Beta curriculum pilot featuring AI Foundations Semester 2 and HTML/CSS tools
